mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `groups` ( id, user_id, name, default_group ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{defaultGroup} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE id = #{groupId}
SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND default_group = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at, COUNT(gp.id) AS good_place_count FROM `groups` g LEFT JOIN good_places gp ON gp.group_id = g.id WHERE g.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.default_group, g.created_at ORDER BY g.default_group DESC, g.created_at ASC
SELECT id, user_id, name, default_group, created_at FROM `groups` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND name = #{name} LIMIT 1
